sources.title: React Flow Documentation
sources.keyClaim: React Flow is a React library for node-based editors where nodes are arbitrary React components positioned on an infinite, zoomable, pannable plane

sources.title: Custom Nodes — React Flow
sources.keyClaim: Custom nodes can render any React component — forms, charts, interactive elements. nodeTypes maps a string to a ComponentType

sources.title: Panning and Zooming — React Flow
sources.keyClaim: Viewport model: camera {x,y,zoom}, pan by drag, zoom by scroll/pinch. Inspired by slippy maps. Design-tool controls available.

sources.title: Performance — React Flow
sources.keyClaim: onlyRenderVisibleElements does AABB culling. React.memo and useCallback prevent unnecessary re-renders. Zustand selector pattern minimizes updates.

sources.title: Contextual Zoom — React Flow
sources.keyClaim: useStore subscribes to zoom level; nodes render different content at different zoom tiers — maps to detailZoom semantic zoom

sources.title: Base Node — React Flow
sources.keyClaim: shadcn-based BaseNode component with header/content/footer sections. CSS utility classes for drag/scroll control (nodrag, nopan, nowheel).

sources.title: xyflow/xyflow — GitHub
sources.keyClaim: React Flow v12, TypeScript-first, MIT license. @xyflow/system provides headless core without UI opinions.

sources.title: RFC — Spatial Queries & Virtualisation in XYFlow
sources.keyClaim: onlyRenderVisibleElements already works. Flatbush spatial index planned for v13. Mount/unmount cost is the real bottleneck, not spatial queries.

sources.title: NodeRenderer source code
sources.keyClaim: NodeRenderer subscribes only to node IDs, not full node data. NodeWrapper handles per-node updates to minimize re-renders.

sources.title: tldraw: Infinite Canvas SDK for React
sources.keyClaim: Whiteboard-first infinite canvas with shapes, drawings, arrows. Not designed for arbitrary HTML panels.

sources.title: Composable primitives for your infinite canvas
sources.keyClaim: Camera system delivers smooth zooming, infinite panning, viewport culling, coordinate transforms.

sources.title: Infinite Canvas with Zoom and Pan — Konva
sources.keyClaim: Canvas 2D infinite canvas with zoom/pan. Not DOM/React component model.

sources.title: Flowscape-UI/canvas-react
sources.keyClaim: React canvas library with pan/zoom, node API, viewport culling. Too young (v1.1, 18 stars).

sources.title: @jamesyong42/infinite-canvas
sources.keyClaim: ECS layout engine + WebGL widgets. Overengineered for our use case.

sources.title: grid-canvas
sources.keyClaim: Grid-based layout canvas. Wrong model — we need freeform positioning, not grid.

sources.title: Infinite Canvas with React Three Fiber
sources.keyClaim: Chunk-based rendering for image canvases. Not for DOM components.

sources.title: How to Create a Figma-like Infinite Canvas in React
sources.keyClaim: Browser-native CSS transform approach. Validates the transform: translate/scale pattern.

sources.title: Browser Sandbox for Agent-Generated HTML
sources.keyClaim: Validated pattern: sandboxed iframe + immutable meta CSP + MessageChannel-scoped bridge for untrusted HTML

sources.title: Play safely in sandboxed IFrames
sources.keyClaim: Google's sandbox best practices: whitelist model, remove all permissions then add back. allow-scripts + allow-same-origin together is dangerous.

sources.title: Content-Security-Policy: sandbox directive
sources.keyClaim: CSP sandbox directive enables sandbox similar to iframe sandbox attribute. Can be set via HTTP header or meta tag.

sources.title: Iframe XSS: postMessage, CSP, Sandboxing
sources.keyClaim: OWASP recommends sandboxed frames for untrusted external content. Security audit patterns for iframe XSS.

sources.title: Creating a Read-Only Iframe Sandbox
sources.keyClaim: MessageChannel-scoped bridge for one-way sandboxed iframe isolation. Validates our BridgeMessage protocol.

sources.title: Capability-Driven UI Patterns Brief
sources.keyClaim: vivim uses canonical manifest approach with 21 UI fields per capability; 3-layer override chain; single discovery endpoint

sources.title: src/canvas/types.ts — vivim-final
sources.keyClaim: CanvasDefinition (HTML/CSS/scriptUrl/bindings/layout), CanvasLayout{x,y,z,w,h}, SandboxPolicy, BridgeMessage protocol — all already defined

sources.title: web/ui/src/ui/registry.ts — vivim-final
sources.keyClaim: UIComponentRegistry: external store, capability>provider>default precedence, P8 sandbox, window.__vivim.ui runtime bridge, localStorage persistence

sources.title: web/ui/src/ui/slots.ts — vivim-final
sources.keyClaim: SLOT_IDS catalog: 11 chat slots (entry, sidebar, thread, bubble, composer, send, attach, streaming, result, confirm, error, header, actionBar)
